articles.title: Zelensky arrives in Türkiye for NATO Summit
articles.summary: President Zelensky arrived in Ankara to participate in the NATO Summit, where he scheduled bilateral meetings with international leaders and discussed air defense capabilities and defense cooperation.

articles.title: Zelensky on his trip to Moscow: It's dangerous there now—there are too many Ukrainian drones
articles.summary: President Zelensky responded to questions from U.S. President Trump about potential Moscow visits, jokingly citing the presence of Ukrainian drones as a reason not to travel there.

articles.title: Zelensky discusses needs for urgent air defense missiles delivery with Rutte
articles.summary: President Zelensky met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte during the NATO summit to discuss urgent delivery of air defense missiles and NATO countries' contributions to defense initiatives.

articles.title: Zelensky reiterates call for Ukraine's NATO membership: It will make us all stronger
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that Ukraine's combat experience and defense capabilities in modern warfare would strengthen NATO, calling for Ukraine's membership in the Alliance.

articles.title: If Ukraine had licenses to produce Patriot systems, it could protect both itself partners, Zelensky says
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that Ukraine could produce Patriot air defense systems domestically if granted U.S. licenses, sufficient to protect Ukraine and assist allied nations.
